reviews.title: Okay Emergency Radio But Tiny Internal Battery
reviews.review_text: This review is for the G-Project G-70W G-Storm Weather Alert Radio + Wireless Speaker. Initial Impressions - The buttons have a nice feel to them. The carabineer seems pretty sturdy, but those connection points seem to be the weakest link as far as water resistance is concerned. Unfortunately, the back panel requires a pretty large screwdriver to open up, which may be hard to find in an emergency scenario. Performance - Unfortunately it only comes with a 2500mAh internal battery, which means it won't even be enough to fully charge one smartphone. The Bluetooth music quality was definitely better than I was expecting for an emergency radio though, and the Seek and Play buttons double as the Bluetooth track controls. Sadly you can't set presets for the Weather Mode, but there are 22 presets for the Radio, which can be set and cycled through easily. The flashlight has 3 modes, High, Low, and flashing which is nice. I love that the Alert function works in all modes including Standby mode if you want. The reception is okay, FM definitely worked better than NOAA in my area though. Finally, you can't use the charging USB port when it's switched to using the backup AA Batteries which really stinks considering the small internal battery, and the USB charging port is only 1A, which means nothing will charge quickly either. Conclusion - The small 2500mAh internal battery, the lack of AA battery to USB charging capability, and the 1A charging port make this hard to recommend. But if you only need a basic emergency alert radio, not a full blown backup battery pack too, this will suffice.
